Analysis of A Case of Drug Interaction Between Tacrolimus and Tigecycline
Wang Lu， Lei Weijie， Gong Xuepeng Department of Pharmacy， Tongji Hospital， Tongji Medical College， Huazhong University of Science ＆ Technology， Wuhan 430030， China ABSTRACT Tacrolimus interacts with many classes of medication， there was one rare case of tacrolimus interacts with tigecycline ． Clinical pharmacists participated in the treatment process of a renal transplantion patient， during the combination use of tigecycline and tacrolimus， the concentration of tacrolimus markedly increased， the drug interaction was identified and intervened between tacrolimus and tigecycline based on the literatures， which was the security for safe and effective drug therapy．他克莫司在器官移植领域使用广泛作为肝脏细胞色素P450 3A4／5 酶系的底物，发生药物相互作用的风险较高。 移植术后感染为常见并发症之一，目前已知他克莫司与多种抗感染药物存在相互作用本文介绍例极少见的他克莫司与替加环素发生药物相互作用的案例，为临床用药提供参考。
